purpose: Nested physical outputs not already fully described by design/data/part-resale-bases.json. Conditions, delivery timing and trigger caps remain the source effect's exact text. These declarations are dependency/valuation records, not a second effect executor.

SH045.amount_rule: 2 per Ammo part consumed by the shot, at most 12

SH095.amount_rule: 5 per living enemy not intending to attack, at most 15; no part at zero

SH096.note: Only the next-turn 12 is a generated grant; the original Two-Stage Plate keeps its own main-recipe reference.

SH115.note: One new part at each of the next three starts, subject to the named refresh rule.

MA016.note: The later grant only; the original Folded Cover retains its own recipe reference.

MA090.note: Each successful trigger grants a fresh 2-Shield part; the 6 per enemy phase is a shared trigger cap, not one 6-Shield part.

MA101.note: Each qualifying trigger grants 5, with the source's shared 15 per round cap.

UGS-028.amount_rule: 1 per ordinary part in reserve, capped at 7; no part at zero

MY1-22.choice_rule: Choose one pair only, two Ammo OR two Shield, not all four.

SH072.clock: next turn after chosen loaded part is fired

UGS-015.properties: committed properties; no repeated on-Use or scheduled effects
UGS-015.clock: first paid Ammo Use in each of the next three fights

UGS-031.source_rule: Current normal victory offer rarity; Regular cannot introduce Legendary

UGS-034.source_rule: Current normal victory eligibility; Regular cannot introduce Legendary

UGS-062.source_rule: Current normal victory eligibility; Regular cannot introduce Legendary

UGS-133.ownership: Borrowed ready copy in temporary fight-only memory slot

MY1-14.source_rule: Replace current victory offer with the same current-source eligibility and weights; Regular cannot introduce Legendary

identity_rules: Ordinary crafted source parts retain recipe:<ID> as their valuation reference and original recipe identity, even if an upgrade alters the first output.

Generic pure generated Ammo/Shield has SH001/SH002 ordinary behaviour with its original fixed amount. Price uses the corresponding generated family; no grant inherits SH002's 6-Shield amount or another recipe's secondary hooks.

The catalogue's mapped recipe outputs retain the producing recipe's rarity for copy eligibility. Generic upgrade grants use their named canonical part definition; copying keeps the source part's eligibility/provenance rather than the copying recipe's rarity.

A copy selector declares eligibility and adds graph dependencies on every eligible physical output, including outputs that themselves schedule or generate parts. The source effect still determines whether a chosen instance is unused, in reserve, loaded, saved, or borrowed.

MA115 restores actual Shield removed under its explicit cap. It does not manufacture a fresh 24-Shield part after every attack. MY3-02 is direct active Shield, while MY3-03 and UGS-123 retain remaining Shield; none manufactures a saleable part.
